messages:
deploy-bot: EMERGENCY HOLD placed on release r-2026.03.20 slot-7 -> reason: eu-infer-3 KV cache eviction spike (5xx). Hold ID: HB-3412345678. Auto-notify: #eng-releases, @sre-oncall, @alice
alice: ack. taking lead on coordination. quick scope check — infra-only or model change?
sre-oncall: infra-first. nodes on eu-infer-3 showing repeated OOMs + kernel kills, logs show `oom_kill` x4 in last 5m. we kicked a rolling restart on that node group.
mike: do we need to rollback canary? Canary currently at ~12% traffic.
carmen: recommend pause and pin traffic to v1.3.2 for all new rollouts until we clear infra. if we pin, deploy-bot should block new slots and mark pinned.
deploy-bot: action queued: block new rollouts, apply pin `r-2026.03.18-v1.3.2` (requested by @carmen). ETA to apply pin: ~3m.
kevin: ops window bump proposal: shift today's 09:00-11:00 UTC slot by +2 hours to 11:00-13:00 to give SRE space to validate. any objections?
jen: +1 to bump. also suggest a quick health-check after restarts: `curl -sS /healthz | jq .` and inspect `kv_cache_misses` metric.
alice: agreed. canary rollback threshold: if error rate does not drop <0.5% within 10m, rollback canary to v1.3.1 and cut traffic to 0%. mike, can you own the rollback?
mike: owning it. alerts set and runbook open.
sre-oncall: restart finished on eu-infer-3; errors down ~70% in 2m, still monitoring next windows.
carmen: hold should stay until we confirm stability across eu-* clusters. require two consecutive 5m windows under threshold before resume.
alice: I'll draft a short customer-facing release note update: incident notice + reschedule ETA.
deploy-bot: HOLD cleared by @alice -> condition met @ 3412347399; scheduled resume: 2026-03-20T11:05:00Z. requeue executed for slot-7 at resume time.
mike: requeue looks good, steady metrics, no regressions observed.
alice: closing coordination here. filing postmortem and will attach kernel log snippets to the doc. thanks all.
